name: Ignition
summary: At a Venture Company camp in the northern Barrens, a trapped pilot needs the key to get free. The spy has taken a shredder without its ignition key and sends you to fetch one from the site supervisor.

sections.title: A Heist Gone Sideways
sections.body: Sputtervalve sent a spy into a Venture Company shredder at the northern Barrens drilling grounds. The operative plans to take the machine and study its workings. Yet its steering and movement column remains locked without the ignition key.

sections.title: Bluffing Under Pressure
sections.body: A goblin worker has spotted the idle shredder, so the hijacker claims its engine has failed. Trapped beneath the glass canopy with workers nearby, the operative points you toward the central derrick. The supervisor keeps spare ignition keys in the upper control office. One of those keys is the pilot’s only way out before the bluff fails.

sections.title: Corporate Jealousy
sections.body: Once the key turns, the thief studies the shredder’s controls. Its arm levers, rotation controls, and stability dampeners are more precise than the clumsy machines operating out of Ratchet. The machine is now a prize of industrial espionage, and the pilot’s way to survive.

faq.answer: An operative connected to Sputtervalve, an engineer in Ratchet, is inside the shredder. The pilot entered the Venture Company operation to steal one of its advanced wood-clearing machines.

faq.q: Why can't the shredder simply drive away?
faq.answer: The shredder’s movement column is locked without its ignition key. The hijacker reached the cockpit, but the machine cannot move until the key unlocks its drive controls.

faq.q: Where is the Ignition Key found?
faq.answer: The Venture Company supervisor has the ignition key. The supervisor is in the control room atop the nearby wooden derrick.

faq.q: Why does Ratchet want a Venture Company shredder?
faq.answer: Ratchet wants a Venture Company shredder because its engineering surpasses the standard models used there. An intact machine could let local tinkerers study its arm controls, speed regulators, and stability systems.
Sputtervalve is a goblin engineer and operative in Ratchet. Sputtervalve watches the Venture Company’s expansion and seeks its mechanical innovations.

faq.q: What happens after the shredder is started?
faq.answer: Turning the key unlocks the shredder’s movement systems. The pilot then tries to drive the hijacked machine out of the hostile drilling camp and back to safety, while an escort operation is underway.

angles.text: The Venture Company’s shredder has precise arm controls and responsive rotation governors, beyond the usual tinkering in Ratchet.
The Venture Company’s reckless deforestation threatens the northern Barrens. Sabotaging or stealing its heavy machinery disrupts that work.
